notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: 'Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.' Expectation from the text: the caster controls the (tapped) opposing creature, it untaps and has haste, so seat 0 can attack the opponent with it this turn (opponent 20 -> 17); control lasts until end of turn, so once the turn ends its owner controls it again (CR 611.2a, 514.2).
